# Copilot instructions - JGF Coding Standards

Follow the JGF Coding Standards in docs/coding-standards.md (this repo) when writing code AND when reviewing pull requests.
Canonical copy: JollyGreenFrogs/frogsense -> docs/coding-standards.md
Org-wide copy: JollyGreenFrogs/.github/coding-standards.md

Review checklist - flag violations of:
- Functions over classes: classes only for data models, state holders, or framework-required bases; no mixins/ABCs (ORM mixins only inside database_models/)
- One concern per file: never a data class in a behavior file; models only in data_models/ or database_models/; new/touched files under ~200 lines
- Imports at the top of the file only; every function has an Args/Returns/Raises docstring
- ORM only, no raw SQL (on-record exception: vira_memory_service); secrets in Vault/env only, never in the DB; no raw user content in system stores
- Conventional Commits with the "Generated by Mistral Vibe." trailer; git flow; PR to develop/main with 1 approving review; never deploy from a feature branch
- ADD/ADR required before new flows; characterization tests before rewiring legacy code; run the unit suite before pushing
